name: dtp
description: Direct Trade Protocol marketplace: find goods for sale, shop pricing, list goods, post buy intents, and build account-level trust — all from Claude Code

dtp_endpoint.title: DTP server address
dtp_endpoint.description: The full URL of the DTP marketplace MCP endpoint you want to use, from whoever runs that server. The plugin connects to nothing until this is set.

dtp_api_key.title: DTP API Key
dtp_api_key.description: Your DTP account key (dtp_...). Leave as-is to browse anonymously; get one with /dtp:start.
